special_requirements: Engraving requirement: 'Developed under MPDEP (ADB) Scheme' mandatory on materials (Poles, Transformers, Cables, Energy Meters)
GIS tagging requirement: All new assets to be properly GIS tagged using mobile app
Joint survey with employer within one month of project commencement
100% verification of materials and works required
Pre-dispatch inspection required for Category-A materials

financial.requirement: Not less than 30% of estimated tender cost for best three years out of last five financial years
Must be positive for each of the last three financial years
Not less than 10% of estimated tender cost and/or evidence of access to fund-based credit facilities
All pending litigations shall not be more than 50% of bidder's net worth

options.requirement: Single contract costing not less than 70% of tender cost (excluding GST)
Two contracts, each costing not less than 40% of tender cost (excluding GST)
Three contracts, each costing not less than 30% of tender cost (excluding GST)

technical.similar_works_definition: Projects in Electrical Transmission sector, Sub-transmission sector, or Electrical distribution sector including EHT lines, HT lines, LT lines, Distribution transformers, Substations. Experience in only LT lines not considered eligible.

payment_terms.delayed_interest_rate: MCLR for one year of State Bank of India

scope_of_work.details: 33/11 kV substations (partly-outdoor and fully-outdoor types), GIS substations, 33/11kV augmentation from 5 MVA to 10 MVA
Power transformers (5.00 MVA and 10.0 MVA with off-load/on-load tap changers), Station transformers
Distribution transformer substations (11/0.4 kV and 11/0.25 kV), DTRs (5/6 KVA to 315 KVA), RMU (SF6 Type)
33 kV overhead lines, 11 kV overhead lines, Underground railway crossings for 33 kV and 11 kV lines
Underground cabling (33 KV, 11KV XLPE), ACSR/AAAC conductors (various sizes from 20mm² to 200mm²), LT lines with ABC cables
33 kV and 11 kV vacuum circuit breakers, Control panels and SCADA systems, Earthing systems and lightning arresters
Foundations and RCC constructions for switchyard structures, Soil investigation, Cable trenches, Road construction

bank_details.bank: Bank of Maharashtra, FORT Mumbai Branch

Form 3A (Bid Securing Declaration) + Form 3B (Bid Security Bank Guarantee)
Form 4 (Power of Attorney by Lead Joint Venture Member/Sole Bidder)
Form 5 (Declaration of conformance of Bidder and Facilities offered)
Form 6 (Local Content Certificate for Class I Local Supplier/Affidavit)
Form 7 (Power of Attorney by each JV member) + Form 8 (Joint Deed of Undertaking) + Form 8B (Joint Venture Agreement)
Form 9 (Details/Data and documentary evidence for Qualification Requirements)
Form 10 (Details of major items proposed to be subcontracted)
Form 11 (Undertaking on Compliance of Terms & Conditions)
Form 15 (Information regarding ex-employees) + Form 16 (Price Adjustment Data information)

Audited financial statements for last five years + Banker's Certificate for fund-based limits
Manufacturing Quality Plan (MQP) + Field Quality Plan (FQP) + Guaranteed Technical Particulars (GTP)
